title: How to add a chance to parry when an ennemy attacks

posts.author: Angelface
posts.body:
Hi everyone !
For my game, I want one of my character to have a chance to parry and counter every time an ennemy attacks her.
It's for the basic turn by turn combat system in RPG Maker MZ.
I think that the best way is to add a troop event where I can set up variables :
If ennemy attacks character, then character is not affected by attack and attacks the "ID latest ennemy who acted"
But I can't find a variable that says "if ennemy attacks". I can only find if character HP is below x
But I want my character to have, let's say, 50% of chance of stopping the attack before it touches her. So this variable can't work.
Does anyone know how to set up variable is ON if ennemy attacks character ?
Thanks !

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Use VS Battle Core action sequences. Put in enemy skills to check target and to roll the parry chance before you use MECH: Action effect. Then if the parry is a success you call a common event that's the parry sequence (and don't use action effect). In the parry sequence you can use motion on the actor and play a "cling" SE and damage the attacking enemy.
EDIT: Oh and in the parry sequence also add MECH: Text Popup (or whatever it was) that says "Parry"

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
If it's just a basic attack counter, you could just give the actor 50% counter attack trait. When I wrote my earlier post I was thinking more complicated sequences. If you wanna do it with action sequences, the idea is for enemy skills that target one dude:
"action sequence stuff"
.
.
.
IF (BattleManger._targets[0].actorId() === 1 && Math.random() < 0.5)
-> Call Common Even (that has parry sequence motions + where you can deal damage to BattleManager._subject)
ELSE
-> MECH: Action effect
.
.
.
